Sliced Volume Rendering with Transfer Functions ... - Visualization Library
The example below demonstrates how to use an arbitrary GLSL program and transfer function to render a volume. The fragment shader used in this example is capable of computing the volume gradient and per-pixel lighting in real-time with up to 4 lights at the same time.
